subjects.title: Things
subjects.description: Everything Stepwise knows you have. Retired ones stay readable.

subject.title: {subject}
subject.description: What this one is called, and what has been learned about it. Anything learned here applies to this one thing and never to others of the same sort.

data_description.retract: Each one shows where it came from and when it was last confirmed.
data_description.retire: It stops matching what you say, but its history stays.
data_description.forget: Anything ticked is removed. A fact that cannot be removed is permanent.

runs.title: Put a run down
runs.description: Closes a run without finishing it. Nothing is lost and nothing is held against you.

saying.title: What to say to it
saying.description:
Say these to whichever assistant you gave Stepwise to.

**Starting** — "Talk me through descaling the kettle." "I'd like to make a rosemary loaf on my bread machine."

**Getting on with it** — "Done." "That's in." "Next."

**Coming back to it** — "Where were we?" Days later is fine. "How's the loaf doing?" picks out one job when several are on the go.

**Asking anything** — "How long has it been resting?" "How many steps left?" Asking never costs you your place.

**Saying what you see** — "It's gone a bit sticky." Recorded against the step and the time. Nothing moves.

**Putting it right** — "No, go back." "Go back, I've not done the salt." "My machine takes the yeast first."

**Stopping** — "Hang on, leave it for now." It keeps your place. "That's it, finished." closes it.

export_run.name: Export a run
export_run.description: The record of a run — every step, note, question and correction, timestamped — as markdown, CSV and rows. With nothing given, the run last touched.

reference.name: Called
reference.description: What the run is called, for instance the rosemary loaf.

list_runs.name: List runs
list_runs.description: Every run in progress, with where each one is and how long since it was last touched.

include_finished.name: Include finished
include_finished.description: Also list runs that are over.

finish_run.name: Close a run
finish_run.description: Close a run from an automation or a button. The same act the options page offers.

outcome.name: How it went
outcome.description: Recorded against the run. It is the note that makes the next one better.

abandoned.name: Stopping rather than finishing
abandoned.description: Recorded as a fact, without judgement.

start_run.name: Start a run
start_run.description: Begin a stored procedure — from a dashboard button, a schedule or a script.

reference.name: Call it
reference.description: What to call this run out loud. One is proposed if you leave it empty.

subject_id.name: Thing
subject_id.description: Which of your things this run is about, if it matters.

reopen_run.name: Pick a run back up
reopen_run.description: Reopen a run that was stopped, exactly where it was left.
